knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says not to alter records to make an outcome appear better, and to use neutral, factual recording.
The lesson says to obtain acknowledgement rather than assuming a message was seen, and to hand over what remains unsafe and what action is pending.
The record the event promptly section says to document date, time, location, people involved, direct observations, immediate actions, notifications and any relevant equipment.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes procedure step 1: Check your own personal safety first, and summon emergency assistance when required.
Learner completes procedure step 2: Give first aid only within your training and local protocols, and do not move an injured person unless needed to prevent further danger.
Learner completes procedure step 3: Record the date, time, location, people involved, direct observations, immediate actions, notifications and any equipment involved.
Learner completes procedure step 4: Use neutral factual language, and separate witness statements from your own observations.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 3: Record the date, time, location, people involved, direct observations, immediate actions, notifications and any equipment involved.
Record of procedure step 5: Keep photos, witness accounts and forms as company policy directs, and do not alter records or post images in personal chats.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 2 is not done: Give first aid only within your training and local protocols, and do not move an injured person unless needed to prevent further danger.
Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Keep photos, witness accounts and forms as company policy directs, and do not alter records or post images in personal chats.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Tell the incoming supervisor what remains unsafe, what has been isolated, who has been contacted and what action is pending.
